name: Photo and map pin / 照片与地图标点
description: Demo: one fixed illustration and one map pin stay on the same page. The picture is an original riverfront drawing, not a photograph, and it is not chosen at random. Participants place one point in a fixed central Shanghai study area. English and Chinese wording are both in the question text. The survey locale is Chinese. 演示：一幅固定插画和一道地图标点在同一页。画面是原创滨水插画，不是照片，也不会随机更换。参与者在固定的上海中心城区范围内标出一个点。题干同时包含中文和英文。问卷语言为中文。
author: SP-Survey

config.title: 这个画面在哪里？ / Where is this view?
config.description: 请看同一页上的固定画面，并在上海地图上标出一个点。画面和地图不会被随机拆开。 / Look at the fixed picture on this page, then place one pin on the Shanghai map. The picture and the map are not split by randomization.

pages.name: page_photo_map
pages.title: 这个画面在哪里？ / Where is this view?
pages.description: 画面是原创插画，每次都相同。地图范围固定在上海中心城区。请用点标出一个位置。 / The picture is an original illustration and is always the same. The map stays on central Shanghai. Mark one point.

elements.name: scene_view
elements.title: 请看这个固定画面。 / Look at this fixed view.
elements.description: 原创滨水插画，不是实拍照片，也不会从媒体库随机抽取。 / Original riverfront illustration, not a photograph, and not a random draw from a media library.
elements.altText: 原创滨水插画：河岸步道、拱桥和一座方塔。 Original illustration of a riverfront promenade, an arch bridge, and a square tower.

elements.name: photo_location
elements.title: 请在上海地图上标出一个点，标出你认为这个画面所在的位置。 / Place one pin on the Shanghai map where you think this view is.
elements.description: 地图已固定在上海中心城区。请选择“点 / Point”，标出一个位置。这一页上的画面和地图保持在一起，不会因随机顺序被拆到不同页面。 / The map is fixed on central Shanghai. Choose Point and mark one place. This picture and map stay together on this page.

studyAreas.label: 上海中心城区 Shanghai. Fixed study extent for this pin task, not the city administrative boundary.
